mapper.select: SELECT IDX AS no, name, score FROM TB_SCORE WHERE name LIKE '%'||#{name}||'%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SCORE (NAME,SCORE) VALUES (#{name, jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{score, jdbcType=BIGINT})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SCORE SET NAME = #{name, jdbcType=VARCHAR},SCORE = #{score, jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE IDX = #{no}
